assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one production game texture atlas, square 1024x1024 image, exactly four columns by four rows of equal square tiles, edge-to-edge with NO gutters, NO borders, NO labels. This atlas is for a serious realistic military FPS made of cubic blocks with pixel textures. Produce photograph-derived, restrained 64x64 logical pixel material scans, each pixel enlarged crisply; realistic weathering and irregular natural variation, low saturation, low contrast at distance, no cartoon outlines. Orthographic flat surface samples, neutral diffuse lighting, no perspective, no 3D blocks, no objects, no dramatic lighting or baked directional shadows. Each tile should repeat seamlessly by itself. Row 1 left to right: fine worn asphalt; coarse aggregate asphalt; cracked asphalt; oil-stained asphalt. Row 2: compact dry earth; muddy soil with shallow tire wear; pale gravel; dark crushed aggregate. Row 3: patchy desaturated olive grass with soil; sun-dried sparse grass; forest floor with leaf litter; damp mossy earth. Row 4: packed beige sand; weathered pale limestone; dark exposed bedrock; broken concrete rubble. Natural olive, earth brown and utilitarian grey palette appropriate to a real airfield, port, estate and river valley. Avoid vivid green, toy-like appearance, plastic, gradients, text, logos and watermarks. Keep all sixteen tiles exactly square and identically sized.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one production military environment architecture texture atlas, square 1024x1024, exactly 4 by 4 identical square tiles, flush grid, no gutters, borders, labels or text. Serious near-realistic military FPS material language rendered as crisp photograph-derived 64x64 logical pixel textures, not cartoon Minecraft colors. Flat front-on material scans only, no cubes or objects, neutral diffuse lighting and no cast shadows. Seamless repeat inside every tile. Row 1 left to right: weathered poured concrete; cracked damp concrete; aged dark red brick with thin dirty mortar; old grey-brown brick. Row 2: faded grey plaster; stained off-white plaster; rugged limestone retaining masonry; utilitarian precast concrete panels. Row 3: galvanised corrugated sheet metal; faded blue painted corrugated steel; weathered red metal roofing; patched rusted sheet roofing. Row 4: dark tarred flat roofing; aged grey slate tiles; dirty industrial blue-grey window panes in a subtle metal frame; weathered brown timber planks. Restrained believable material colors, wear and small irregular details, matte rough surfaces, not bright plastic or decorative patterns. All 16 tiles must occupy exact equal grid cells. No perspective, no lighting gradients, no bevels, no text or logos.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a single square 1024x1024 production military/industrial texture atlas, strict 4x4 grid of sixteen edge-to-edge equal square tiles with no gutters or labels. Crisp 64x64 logical pixel art derived from realistic material photography, a serious combat game on cubic geometry. Neutral front-on scans, subtle utilitarian wear, low saturation and coherent scale. Each cell independently seamless. Row 1: faded olive shipping container steel; battered blue shipping container steel; rusty red container steel; light grey cargo steel. Row 2: dusty tan sandbag fabric; dark olive sandbag fabric; worn military wooden crate boards without writing; water-darkened dock timber. Row 3: industrial non-slip floor plate; steel ventilation grate; faded yellow-black safety stripe paint on rough steel; corroded orange-brown structural steel. Row 4: dark rough tree bark; pale weathered bark; realistic dark olive foliage surface; dry brown-olive foliage. No objects, cubes, perspective, cartoon outlines, intense highlights, saturated neon greens, text, logos or watermark. Exact equal cells suitable for direct GPU texture atlas use.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one square 1024x1024 transparent PNG texture atlas containing exactly a 2x2 grid of four equally sized ladder segment tiles. A functional Minecraft-style wall ladder for a serious realistic military FPS with cubic world geometry and pixel textures. Each tile is a front-on repeating one-metre ladder section: two straight continuous vertical side rails at 20% and 80% of tile width, three evenly spaced horizontal rungs connecting them, transparent empty space around and between all rails/rungs. The rails must touch the top and bottom tile edges so segments repeat vertically seamlessly. Crisp 64x64 logical pixels per tile, realistic worn steel grain, readable silhouette, neutral diffuse light, no perspective or shadows outside the ladder. Variants in reading order: galvanised dull grey steel; weathered olive painted steel; rusty brown steel; chipped industrial dark grey steel. Four equal cells exactly aligned, no grid lines, no captions or text, no background, no wall, no extra objects. Actual transparent background.
